description: The versionless Capella stringfun.md carries nine version-availability statements; the versioned Server 8.0 page carries zero. Stripping satisfied gates from server/current is reasonable in itself - a 7.6 gate always holds on 8.0 - but the 8.0 badges are not redundant and have gone too: COMPRESS() and UNCOMPRESS() are new in 8.0, and a reader upgrading from 7.6 cannot tell that from this page.
